caption: The drawing features a detailed, colored illustration of a woven textile or fabric sample, occupying the upper half of the page and rendered in horizontal bands. The textile is composed of alternating patterns and colors, including light beige, rose red, deep blue, and off-white. The design includes ornamental motifs, such as floral and geometric patterns, spanning across different bands. On the left side, three vertical stripes in shades of light green, rose red, and blue run parallel to the bands but are much narrower. The bottom section of the textile contains an inscription in a rectangular cartouche framed with blue and beige: "MADE BY JOHN MEL LINGER & SON" in gold letters on a blue and gold background, and directly below it, the number "1837" appears in large white numbers on a rose red background. Decorative fringe details are shown at the bottom edge of the textile, rendered with individual strands. The artist’s signature “Christopher Webb” appears in the lower right corner outside the textile area.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
